defect.message: The bridge uses "Steel plate girders acting compositely with a 0.25 m cast-in-place deck slab ... steel girder depth 1.4 m, top flange 400 mm x 25 mm, bottom flange 500 mm x 30 mm, web 1345 mm x 16 mm, steel Q345". The knowledge graph covers only concrete girder types (small_box, t_girder, cast_box) with concrete section schemas, and its material rules are limited to concrete grades (JTG 3362-2018 Table 3.1.5 for Ec). There are no rules, clauses or section types for steel plate girders, steel-composite sections, or steel grade Q345, so no girder.single.A/I, girder.A/I, girder.Ec or girder.gamma decision can be derived. The component lies outside the scope of the knowledge graph.
